## Analysis by Restaurant

```{r restaurant_analysis}
# SQL query to analyze restaurant performance
restaurant_query <- "
SELECT 
    r.RestaurantName AS Restaurant,
    COUNT(v.VisitID) AS Total_Visits,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.CustomerID) AS Unique_Customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.CustomerID)
     FROM Visits v2
     INNER JOIN Customers c2 ON v2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
     WHERE v2.RestaurantID = r.RestaurantID 
     AND c2.LoyaltyMember = TRUE) AS Loyalty_Customers,
    ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(v.FoodBill * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)), 0), 2) AS Food_Revenue,
    ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(v.AlcoholBill * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)), 0), 2) AS Alcohol_Revenue,
    ROUND(IFNULL(SUM((v.FoodBill + v.AlcoholBill) * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)), 0), 2) AS Total_Revenue
FROM 
    Restaurants r
    LEFT JOIN Visits v ON r.RestaurantID = v.RestaurantID
GROUP BY 
    r.RestaurantID, r.RestaurantName
ORDER BY 
    Total_Revenue DESC
"

# Execute query and fetch results
restaurant_data <- dbGetQuery(mydb, restaurant_query)

# Format numbers for display
restaurant_display <- restaurant_data %>%
  mutate(
    Food_Revenue = paste0("$", format(Food_Revenue, big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2)),
    Alcohol_Revenue = paste0("$", format(Alcohol_Revenue, big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2)),
    Total_Revenue = paste0("$", format(Total_Revenue, big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2))
  )

# Create table with reduced column widths
restaurant_display %>%
  kable(
    caption = "Restaurant Performance Summary (Revenue in thousands)",
    col.names = c("Restaurant", "Visits", "Unique\nCust.", "Loyalty\nMemb.", 
                  "Food\nRev.", "Alcohol\nRev.", "Total\nRev."),
    align = c('l', 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r'),
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep = ""
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"),
    font_size = 8,
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "3.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:7, width = "1.5cm")
```

*Note: Revenue figures exclude tips and discounts*

## Sales & Visit Analytics

```{r sales_analytics}
# Get current year and calculate prior 2 years dynamically
current_date <- Sys.Date()
current_year <- year(current_date)
start_year <- current_year - 2
end_year <- current_year - 1

# SQL query for sales analytics
sales_query <- sprintf("
SELECT 
    r.RestaurantName AS Restaurant,
    ROUND(SUM((v.FoodBill + v.AlcoholBill) * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)), 2) AS Total_Revenue,
    ROUND(AVG((v.FoodBill + v.AlcoholBill) * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)), 2) AS Avg_Per_Party,
    ROUND(AVG(v.PartySize), 2) AS Avg_Party_Size,
    COUNT(v.VisitID) AS Visit_Count
FROM 
    Restaurants r
    LEFT JOIN Visits v ON r.RestaurantID = v.RestaurantID
WHERE 
    YEAR(v.VisitDate) BETWEEN %d AND %d
GROUP BY 
    r.RestaurantID, r.RestaurantName
ORDER BY 
    Total_Revenue DESC
", start_year, end_year)

# Execute query
sales_data <- dbGetQuery(mydb, sales_query)

# Check if we have data
if(nrow(sales_data) > 0) {
  sales_display <- sales_data %>%
    head(10) %>%  # Top 10 restaurants
    mutate(
      Total_Revenue = paste0("$", format(Total_Revenue, big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2)),
      Avg_Per_Party = paste0("$", format(Avg_Per_Party, big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2)),
      Avg_Party_Size = format(Avg_Party_Size, nsmall = 1),
      Visit_Count = format(Visit_Count, big.mark = ",")
    )
  
  # Create table with restaurants as rows (avoids width issues)
  sales_display %>%
    kable(
      caption = paste0("Sales \\& Visit Analytics (", start_year, "-", end_year, ")"),
      col.names = c("Restaurant", "Total Revenue", "Avg Per Party", "Avg Party Size", "Total Visits"),
      align = c('l', 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r')
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "center"
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("No data available for the specified period")
}
```

*Analysis period: `r paste(start_year, "-", end_year)`*

## Trend by Year for Florida

```{r florida-trend, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Query for Florida restaurant revenue by year
florida_trend <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "
  SELECT 
    YEAR(v.VisitDate) as Year,
    SUM(v.FoodBill * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)) as FoodRevenue,
    SUM(v.AlcoholBill * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)) as AlcoholRevenue,
    SUM((v.FoodBill + v.AlcoholBill) * (1 - v.DiscountApplied)) as TotalRevenue
  FROM Visits v
  JOIN Restaurants r ON v.RestaurantID = r.RestaurantID
  WHERE r.State = 'FL' OR r.State = 'Florida'
  GROUP BY YEAR(v.VisitDate)
  ORDER BY Year
")

# Create line chart
if (nrow(florida_trend) > 0) {
  # Create the plot using ggplot2
  p <- ggplot(florida_trend, aes(x = Year, y = TotalRevenue)) +
    geom_line(color = "#4472C4", size = 2) +
    geom_point(color = "#4472C4", size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("$", format(round(TotalRevenue, 0), big.mark = ","))),
              vjust = -1.5, size = 3.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format(scale = 0.001, suffix = "K"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15)),
                       limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = florida_trend$Year) +
    labs(title = "Total Revenue Trend for Florida Restaurants",
         subtitle = "Combined Food and Alcohol Revenue by Year",
         x = "Year",
         y = "Total Revenue",
         caption = paste("Data as of", format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y"))) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 1),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linetype = "dashed"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic")
    )
  
  print(p)
  
} else {
  cat("No data available for Florida restaurants")
}
```

```{r florida-summary, results='asis'}
# Create summary table for Florida
if (nrow(florida_trend) > 0) {
  # Calculate year-over-year changes
  florida_summary <- florida_trend %>%
    mutate(
      YoY_Change = TotalRevenue - lag(TotalRevenue),
      YoY_Percent = round((YoY_Change / lag(TotalRevenue)) * 100, 1)
    )
  
  # Format for display
  florida_display <- florida_summary %>%
    mutate(
      FoodRevenue = paste0("$", format(round(FoodRevenue), big.mark = ",")),
      AlcoholRevenue = paste0("$", format(round(AlcoholRevenue), big.mark = ",")),
      TotalRevenue = paste0("$", format(round(TotalRevenue), big.mark = ",")),
      YoY_Change = ifelse(is.na(YoY_Change), "-",
                         paste0(ifelse(YoY_Change > 0, "+", ""),
                               "$", format(round(YoY_Change), big.mark = ","))),
      YoY_Percent = ifelse(is.na(YoY_Percent), "—",
                          paste0(ifelse(YoY_Percent > 0, "+", ""), YoY_Percent, "%"))
    ) %>%
    select(Year, FoodRevenue, AlcoholRevenue, TotalRevenue, YoY_Change, YoY_Percent)
  
  # Display table
  florida_display %>%
    kable(
      caption = "Florida Revenue Breakdown by Year",
      col.names = c("Year", "Food Revenue", "Alcohol Revenue", 
                   "Total Revenue", "YoY Change", "YoY %"),
      align = c('c', 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r')
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "center"
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(4, bold = TRUE)
  
  # Add summary statistics
  cat("\n")
  cat("**Summary Statistics:**\n\n")
  cat(paste("- Total Years Analyzed:", nrow(florida_trend), "\n"))
  cat(paste("- Average Annual Revenue: $", 
            format(round(mean(florida_summary$TotalRevenue), 2), big.mark = ","), "\n"))
  cat(paste("- Peak Revenue Year:", florida_trend$Year[which.max(florida_trend$TotalRevenue)], "\n"))
  cat(paste("- Total Revenue (All Years): $",
            format(round(sum(florida_trend$TotalRevenue), 2), big.mark = ","), "\n"))
  
  # Calculate growth rate if we have more than one year
  if(nrow(florida_trend) > 1) {
    overall_growth <- ((florida_trend$TotalRevenue[nrow(florida_trend)] - 
                       florida_trend$TotalRevenue[1]) / 
                       florida_trend$TotalRevenue[1]) * 100
    cat(paste("- Overall Growth Rate:", sprintf("%.1f%%", overall_growth), "\n"))
  }
}
```

## Appendix: Database Summary


```{r appendix, results='asis'}
# Get summary statistics from database
summary_stats <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RestaurantID) FROM Restaurants) as TotalRestaurants,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM Customers) as TotalCustomers,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ServerEmpID) FROM Servers) as TotalServers,
    COUNT(*) as TotalVisits,
    MIN(VisitDate) as EarliestVisit,
    MAX(VisitDate) as LatestVisit,
    SUM(FoodBill + AlcoholBill) as TotalRevenue,
    AVG(FoodBill + AlcoholBill) as AvgRevenue
  FROM Visits
")

# Get state distribution
state_dist <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "
  SELECT 
    r.State,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.RestaurantID) as RestaurantCount,
    COUNT(v.VisitID) as VisitCount,
    SUM(v.FoodBill + v.AlcoholBill) as Revenue
  FROM Restaurants r
  LEFT JOIN Visits v ON r.RestaurantID = v.RestaurantID
  GROUP BY r.State
  ORDER BY Revenue DESC
")

# Display summary
cat("**Database Overview:**\n\n")
cat(paste("- Total Restaurants:", summary_stats$TotalRestaurants, "\n"))
cat(paste("- Total Customers:", summary_stats$TotalCustomers, "\n"))
cat(paste("- Total Servers:", summary_stats$TotalServers, "\n"))
cat(paste("- Total Visits:", format(summary_stats$TotalVisits, big.mark = ","), "\n"))
cat(paste("- Date Range:", summary_stats$EarliestVisit, "to", summary_stats$LatestVisit, "\n"))
cat(paste("- Total Revenue: $", format(round(summary_stats$TotalRevenue, 2), big.mark = ","), "\n"))
cat(paste("- Average Revenue per Visit: $", format(round(summary_stats$AvgRevenue, 2), big.mark = ","), "\n"))

# Display state distribution table
cat("\n**Restaurant Distribution by State:**\n\n")


state_display <- state_dist %>%
  mutate(
    Revenue = paste0("$", format(round(Revenue), big.mark = ","))
  ) %>%
  head(10)  # Show top 10 states

state_display %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("State", "Restaurants", "Visits", "Total Revenue"),
    align = c('l', 'r', 'r', 'r')
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```
